{{Quote|Understand, please, as Caretaker of the Temple of First Knowledge, my responsibilities include all of the old lore.|Astaal Vilbum to Mace Windu|<ref name="R33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]]</ref>}}
The '''Caretaker of First Knowledge''' was a title used to denote the leader of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] throughout the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As leader of the First Knowledge Council, the Caretaker had direct oversight of the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and its satellite facilities, and was tasked with the protection of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and its [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vaults]] deep within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Over the history of the Order, there had been over fourteen generations of Caretakers, each one contributing their insights to the Council and overseeing the curriculum at the academy. After the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were enacted, [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]] was appointed to the position, using her authority to help reconstitute the Order's teachings following the long period of [[New Sith Wars|war]].<ref name="TJP" /> Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Astaal Vilbum]] held the title, and presided over the awakening of the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of [[Volfe Karkko]], an event that had not occurred for thirteen generations of Caretakers.<ref name="R33" />
